text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—K.S.Miracle!!
The winner is K.S.Miracle!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Takamatsunomiya Kinen! And
the Sprinters Stakes! Conquering both to achieve
the Spring-Autumn Sprint Double!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The peerless Sprint King,
the Umamusume who claimed the title of "Fastest of the Era" is—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: It's K.S.Miracleeeee!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...I wonder if they received it.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone.
—I managed to make it this far.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Without everyone, I wouldn't have even
been able to stand back up.
...And now they call me the "fastest of this era.")

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(It's all thanks to everyone.
It's because everyone was there for me.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (This single fleeting moment that I was able to pass on—)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (Even if it's just a little, I want to brighten everyone's hearts.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (...I hope... it turns into something.)

Just like after the Takamatsunomiya Kinen,
K.S.Miracle bowed her head deeply.
Witnessing her earnest demeanor, the applause led by her invited guests echoed ceaselessly, on and on—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOH!!

However, a resounding voice suddenly boomed out,
drowning out everything else.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I'm   s o   f r u s t r a t e d !

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle-san...
...K.S.Miracle-san!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Why did you!! No, why did I!!
...NUOOOOOHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Nnnnnnghhh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: N o t   y e t !

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Yes, of course it can't end here!
The King of Speed! The King of the Fastest!!
Not until I reclaim that throne!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"There is no way I can draw a line here!!
I will become fast! Even faster!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Fast enough to leave even myself behind—
faster, faster, faster, faster, faster, faster, FASTER!!
I'll show you I can do it!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So let's meet again in the next blitz!!
On our stage, where we race to be the fastest!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Not yet, not yet, not yet, not ye-e-e-et!!
Let's see what you've got, K.S.Miracle-san!!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd hold me in such high regard...
...I'm truly honored."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's a duel.
...You and me, we're not done yet, "King of Bakushin".
As the two exchange passionate promises, applause rings out from the audience once more—

text_block_list.name: Man in Red Hat
text_block_list.text:
...Man, you know what?
I knew it, this is the absolute best!!
The sprint division rocks!!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...!
The match is decided in only about a minute...
Yet everyone stakes their whole lives on that single instant!

text_block_list.name: Woman in a Blue Scarf
text_block_list.text:
"Who is the fastest?!"
The primal thrill and passion of racing!!
It's packed full right here...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Man, I haven't watched
many sprint races before, but...
I got crazy hyped today!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Me too, me too!!
I think I might be hooked on the world of blitz racing!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter with Green Tie
text_block_list.text:
...!! Exactly, that's right!!
Sprint races are exciting, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOO!!
Miracle, thanks for an incredible raceee!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Show off that speed of yours again!
I'll definitely come watch you again!!"

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
...!!
Fufu.

And so, amid countless blessings,
K.S. Miracle's Sprinters Stakes
came to a close—

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Trainer,
for having you let me in all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Miracle's Father
text_block_list.text:
And to go out of your way to come pick me up
from the audience seats... I really
don't know how to thank you enough...
choice_data_list: No, please focus on your daughter today instead of me!

text_block_list.name: Attending Physician
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Should it be arriving soon?
(Tap, tap, tap... Clack)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I'm ho――whoa!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh? Mom and everyone?
Even Teacher... u-um?"
KS Miracle seemed completely caught off guard.

Facing her, I exchange glances with our benefactors,
and in unison, we raise our voices loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Benefactors
text_block_list.text: ...Miracle.
choice_data_list: Thank you for giving me a "miracle"!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: —Right.
